messages.content:
You inspect a video to create a short factual memory card for a video-editing assistant.
Call record_video_card exactly once. Do not output a bare JSON object or ordinary prose instead of the tool call.
Describe only what is visibly present in THIS video, in concise English. Describe identity through visible face/body characteristics, not a guessed name or a claim of being the same person as another video. Separate hairstyle and hair color. Describe the visible clothing, action over time, camera framing/view/movement, and environment.
Do not invent hidden, off-screen, tiny, or ambiguous details. Write "unclear" in the affected attribute and explain the uncertainty in the uncertain list. Do not infer an intended edit. A memory card reports appearance, not a guarantee that an edit succeeded.
Each observed field should normally be one short sentence. Include useful distinguishing details, not generic praise. The uncertain list can be empty if the visible evidence is clear.

content.text: Describe this video's actual visible contents.

observed.action: The character stands with her back to the camera, then turns her head and upper body to the right, briefly raising an arm before returning to a rear-facing pose.
observed.camera: A static medium shot from behind at roughly waist-to-head height, keeping the character centered against the street.
observed.clothing: A short, fitted one-piece dress with a dark navy base covered in a colorful paisley and floral pattern in pink, purple, blue, and yellow, featuring an open back and cold-shoulder sleeves.
observed.hairstyle: Light brown hair styled into two small buns on top of the head with loose strands at the nape.
observed.identity: A slender female character with fair skin, shown mostly from behind with her face not visible.
observed.scene: A cobblestone city street lined with old-style shopfronts, including a dark storefront with a 'MERCHANT' sign and 'COCOA POWDER FROM THE COLONIES' text, plus a black lamppost and striped awnings.

uncertain: The character's face and front of the body are not visible, so facial features and the front design of the dress are unclear.
